summary: Frontend-only re-test after navy accent was brightened to #1E3A6B. Verified computed color rgb(30, 58, 107) on all 10 page H1 titles (home/assetti/processi/finanza/percorso/contatti/quando/metriche/ai/liquidita), the header brand-link (checked on every page), Home 'Scopri di piu' links (area-assetti/processi/finanza), Home 'Leggi' links (highlight-quando/metriche), footer-scrivimi-link and Contatti email/LinkedIn links. Zero elements inside <main> with computed opacity<0.9 on any of the 10 routes (no framer-motion regression). All 6 top-nav links route correctly via SPA clicks and each target H1 renders. All 5 deep links resolve to the correct URLs. Content sections intact: /assetti-societari, /processi, /finanza (Aziende, Startup, Come lavoro) and /percorso (Studio e prime esperienze, Consulenza per gruppi bancari e imprese industriali, Ruoli esecutivi e di governo, Oggi). Per-page document.title correct and unique on all 10 routes. No console errors/warnings captured. Backend testing skipped (static site, no backend).

issues: Minor/optional: 'Scopri di piu' and 'Leggi' link text is navy but at 15-18px with a very light navy-soft (32% alpha) underline it reads faintly next to the dark gray body copy; consider slightly heavier weight or higher-opacity underline for stronger affordance. Not a contrast failure - navy #1E3A6B on white is ~8.8:1.

critical_code_review_comments: tailwind.config.js navy DEFAULT #1E3A6B is correctly picked up; navy-soft rgba(30,58,107,0.32) used only for link underlines - fine.
Optional accessibility: FadeIn in Editorial.jsx still animates unconditionally; honoring prefers-reduced-motion would be an improvement (carried over from iteration_1).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Base URL https://governance-startup.preview.emergentagent.com. Static React SPA, no backend. Iteration 2 verified navy accent = rgb(30, 58, 107) on H1s, brand, all Home/footer/Contatti links; content and opacity integrity on all 10 routes; nav clicks; 5 deep links; document.title per page. Useful assertions to reuse: getComputedStyle(el).color === 'rgb(30, 58, 107)' and counting elements inside <main> with opacity<0.9.
rca_of_the_issue: User perceived black-and-white because previous navy #1B2A4A was near-black and was not applied to H1 headings. Fix (navy -> #1E3A6B plus text-navy on PageTitle h1 and header brand) is verified effective: all target elements now compute to rgb(30, 58, 107).
